# Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)

Original OM-5 1.2 port work on a Caduceus E-P7 fork; camera safety ladder passed, no features released.

[Contribution home](https://github.com/tadejs/caduceus-om5/pull/1). The owner reports five camera test steps (C1–C5) passed on an original OM-5 on 1.2. The COLOR 1–3 back end has run only in the emulator, and nothing has been released. The work is on branch om5-port; main is an unchanged copy of Caduceus for E-P7.
